summary: Inherited Azure tags now appear in every collection mode, and installs run more smoothly.

fixes.title: Inherited Azure tags in every collection mode
fixes.text: Azure records collected in parts, as larger installations do, now carry the tags they inherit from resource group, subscription and management groups. The log says how many were read.

fixes.title: New installs no longer wait for sign-in keys
fixes.text: The install now creates the web app's sign-in key in your secure key store and grants its use itself. If you may not assign roles, the grant is listed as a task.
